title: Soldout Productions to take over programming at Switzerland’s Caribana Festival
summary: Swiss promoter Soldout Productions is to take over programming and booking for Caribana Festival from 2027 onwards, in a move that will see the longtime promotion partner take strategic control from promoter Just Because. Following a recent change in Caribana’s management structure, Soldout promoters Julien Rouyer, Yannick Maffli, and Marc Lambelet will be “working together on the 2027 edition and beyond”, the company said. The move will also see Just Because founder Samuel Galley step down from the festival organisation. title: Domestic events fund can ‘unlock full potential’ of New Zealand
summary: New Zealand has announced plans to establish a major events funding scheme to attract international cultural events, the latest in a series of efforts to enhance the country’s concert-hosting capabilities. Funded through the country’s International Visitor Conservation and Tourism Levy (IVL), which can cost travellers NZD$100 (€50), the expanded initiative is designed to give regional authorities greater long-term security when vying for major events. title: Glastonbury tickets reach highest-ever price for 2027
summary: Following its 2026 fallow year, Glastonbury organisers have confirmed ticket prices will top £400 (€465) for the first time in the famed festival’s history. Tickets for the UK festival’s next edition, set for 23-27 June 2027, will cost attendees £408 (€475), which includes a £5 (€6) booking fee, a roughly 8% bump in price from 2025’s fee-inclusive price of £378.50 (€440). Since 2023, the cost of a general Glastonbury ticket has risen around 6% between editions, after rising around 26% from 2019 to 2023 during the pandemic-caused pause . summary: The Music Industry Therapist Collective (MITC) has announced a fund of $272,000 to support 50 touring teams with mental health support each year, in a scheme set to last three years.
